subject: App disconnects when deployed, no logs

messages.author: d41035f15b0feb55
messages.subject: App disconnects when deployed, no logs
parts:
I have successfully deployed my shiny app to shinyapps.io where it says it is running, but when opened it disconnects from the server immediately, before any plots appear. The app runs fine locally and I am not sure the source of this issue.

https://collnell.shinyapps.io/basa_app/

I have read through previous threads that suggest using rsconnect::showLogs() and in the shinyapp.io dashboard, but nothing appears. 

Does anyone have a suggestion on how to address this issue?
Thanks

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] App disconnects when deployed, no logs
parts:
Hi Colleen,
I am not sure why the logs are not showing up, but one of our engineers was able to find that you have a call to setwd() which is using an absolute path.  You will want that to be a relative path instead.
We will need to figure out why the logs aren't being captured properly.
-Tareef
